rule: Use original peer-reviewed publications for biological diagnoses and quantitative claims; cited scientific databases for taxonomy, published distribution and ecology; IUCN/DENR for separately dated conservation. Store source URL, access date, source type and publication or assessment date. Do not duplicate database text or redistribute images without rights.

sources.title: American Society of Mammalogists Mammal Diversity Database
sources.notes: Current version 2.5, July 28 2026. Primary mammalian nomenclature baseline, not a detailed morphology key.

sources.title: Mammalian Species journal species accounts
sources.notes: Use exact species article and article publication date; older taxonomy should be checked against current MDD.

sources.title: Synopsis of Philippine Mammals
sources.notes: Site last extensively updated 2010. Cite as historical context; verify current taxonomy and range against more recent research.

sources.title: Philippine Mammal Project publications
sources.organization: Philippine Mammal Project / Field Museum collaborators
sources.notes: Follow through to individual studies for new morphology, ecology and occurrence claims.

sources.title: Bat Conservation International bat profiles
sources.notes: Secondary organization profiles. Prefer linked original bat research for quantitative or taxonomic claims.

sources.title: IUCN Red List
sources.organization: International Union for Conservation of Nature
sources.notes: Cite the exact species assessment and assessment year. Never convert an IUCN global category into Philippine DENR legal status.

sources.title: AmphibiaWeb
sources.notes: Check account sources and update dates. Cross-check naming with AMNH taxonomy and original descriptions.

sources.title: Amphibian Species of the World, Version 6.2
sources.notes: Cite exact retrieval date since records update continuously. Primary taxonomic reference complementing AmphibiaWeb.

sources.title: The Reptile Database
sources.notes: Cite specific species page and access date. Diagnosis may be a transcription or summary; use the cited taxonomic paper for full differential.

sources.title: Animal Diversity Web
sources.notes: Student-authored species pages. Supporting cross-check only; not the sole reference for critical facts, field diagnosis or dated conservation status.
